facade.scope: Real native comments in both document history families through the explicitly selected SDK facade. Composite guards, old-store refusals, read-only former authors, old offline peer and exact future native histories. No independent managed storage or authenticated relay capability is implied.

storage.scope: Genuine normal native histories with synthetic IndexedDB/Web Locks. All four document/comment families, immutable lane namespaces, cold current-policy recovery, versions, offline peer and future native Undo/Redo; not physical durability, relay/server generations, room activation or complete V1.

readOnly.scope: Actual native document histories and original paired comments through managed SDK storage, synthetic IndexedDB/Web Locks, exact cold current-policy recovery, failed save/lost ack retries and later separately granted future history. No independent review-generation storage, physical durability, relay generation or activation qualification.

segmented.scope: Actual normal native owners and SDK; synthetic IDB/Web Locks. Public binding replacement, deletion and accessors cannot redirect capture or ownership cleanup. Not physical crash durability or whole-room activation.

original.scope: Unchanged native original/search/document and paired durable families; synthetic IDB/Web Locks. Public binding changes cannot redirect capture, backup, version admission or cleanup. No physical crash-durability claim.

relay.scope: Genuine idle relay sessions and actual native owners with synthetic IDB/Web Locks. Direct guards reject own shadow bindings without executing getters. No relay connection, authenticated server or physical durability claim.

beforeDevelopmentControls.scope: Actual earlier development archives, not a claim that these new session APIs existed in the previous root release.

scope: Explicit SDK comment-generation lifecycle and a separate atomic client store selecting original/segmented document and comment histories independently. Real native exact cold/future history, immutable lane file keys, uncertain-save retries and source custody through fresh public archives. Native Rust and normal runtime bytes carried only after exact input/artifact verification.
limitations: New family is refused by old relay, source/asset, participant and room adapters; matching integrations remain work.
Native server/log generations, complete provider/client reconciliation, historic-copy decisions and authenticated room activation remain open.
Existing native Undo/archive limits are not widened. Live saves still serialize complete bounded native archives; no approved latency or unlimited-lifetime claim.
Synthetic IndexedDB/Web Locks are not physical crash durability or cross-device writer fencing.
No browser-specific, clipboard, IME, VoiceOver, historical WebKit repair or V1 release gate is qualified.
No version, tag, push, publication or deployment is promoted.
